title: GPU(MJWarp) 2-robot wide-door navigation gate — acquisition FAIL

calibration.note: own-command odometry only; the appearance detector profile was NOT re-calibrated on this scene

input_audit.scope: capability boundary: controllers never receive world/model/evaluator; smoke has no holding

appearance.finding: profile hue values are consistent with OpenCV H (0-180) units while rgb_to_hsv returns degrees (0-360): under OpenCV units the same frame has 1583 px in 110-114, under degrees 0. Even under OpenCV units the dark indigo floor (OpenCV H ~105-108, V~90) sits inside the S/V band, so the profile also fires on the floor; visgoal found the same floor/zone-paint confusion on GPU renders. The profile was never calibrated on this scene profile.

cause: Two independent causes: (1) hue unit mismatch (profile OpenCV 0-180 vs code degrees 0-360), and (2) profile/scene mismatch - the 36-frame calibration was not captured on walls_floor_contrast_v5_indigo110_s80, where the dark indigo floor is inside the S/V band. Fixing units alone would fire on floor pixels, not on the zone painting, so it was not shipped. The controller has no search/acquisition policy, so it held with no_destination (fail closed).
unverified: whether a scene-specific appearance profile plus a search policy can reach zone B
next: scene-specific appearance calibration (eval-only known poses) + search/acquisition policy; any profile/threshold change requires explicit user approval (one change per gate)
